_readme: Per-host FETCH policy for scripts/build_corpus.py (read via scripts/host_policy.py). A 'suspended' host is never requested by the loader — neither as a registry URL nor as any redirect hop (DOI resolvers, download/CDN links, the curl fallback): its registry rows are skipped without a manifest failure row, do not age toward pruning, and prune_corpus leaves its existing rows (including documents already held) untouched. A host covers its subdomains. This is a fetch suspension, not a corpus exclusion — use registry/eligibility.json for that. Every backend listed must be disabled (check_contracts).

escholarship.org.reason: policy: CloudFront refuses an identified bot UA; browser impersonation is WAF avoidance (Codex 2026-09-24); resume only if an honest identity or an explicitly permitted API/download route works

mdpi.com.reason: network wall: MDPI answers a host-wide HTTP 403 to both requests and curl from this operator's network (re-probed 2026-08-28; until 2026-09-25 documented only as find_sources.PAUSED_PDF_HOSTS and prune_corpus.TRANSIENT_403_HOSTS). Content is often CC BY; resume only if an honest client is served again

ssrn.com.reason: policy: SSRN (papers.ssrn.com, reached via doi.org/10.2139 redirects) answers HTTP 403 through a Cloudflare challenge from this network (observed 2026-09-25); WAF or browser workarounds are forbidden and SSRN records state 'All rights reserved'. SSRN-origin works are registered only through a separately licensed copy on another host
